headline: Lead with their problem, not my calendar.
paraphrase: My openers ask for 15 minutes before I've earned them. Maya took reply rate from 9% to 31% in 6 weeks by leading with the prospect's problem instead.
action_steps: 1. Rewrite the first line of my top sequences to name a problem the prospect can verify.
2. Remove the meeting ask from first touches.
3. Compare reply rate on old vs new openers after 6 weeks.
